principles: Audit-only: gates never read the new fields
New fields excluded from the finding integrity signature
Reuse evidenceState validation + learning-store; no parallel store
Signature-registry prevents synonym-tag drift; active needs human approval
drivers: Must not break existing finding_dismiss/resolve/add callers
Must keep gate decisions deterministic (no audit field reads)
Must keep legacy findings verifiable (signature unchanged)

options.name: additive-optional-audit-only-fields
pros: No breaking change (all fields optional; dismissReasonType optional)
Audit-only keeps gates deterministic; new fields excluded from signature
Reuses the existing evidenceState validation pattern and learning-store
cons: Touches existing finding handlers (back-compat risk, mitigated by smoke)
signature-registry adds a small CLI surface

options.name: separate-sidecar-outcome-store
cons: Splits finding outcome data across two stores (harder to query/audit)
Duplicates persistence + signing concerns; diverges from the execution plan

rationale: The execution plan mandates in-place additive capture with audit-only/excluded-from-gates discipline; a sidecar store would split finding outcome data and diverge from the plan. Back-compat risk is contained by optional-only fields + a no-regression smoke.

preMortem.scenario: A gate starts reading an audit field
preMortem.trigger: Someone wires resolutionType/evidenceStrength into advisory.ts confidence weighting
preMortem.consequence: Reviewer-supplied labels become gate inputs -> non-determinism
preMortem.mitigation: audit-only comments on the fields; smoke asserts advisory gate decision identical with/without the fields; reviewers verify advisory.ts unchanged

preMortem.scenario: dismissReasonType shipped as required breaks callers
preMortem.trigger: Marking the enum required in the schema
preMortem.consequence: Every existing finding_dismiss call/script/replay breaks on first ship
preMortem.mitigation: Field is optional; smoke covers a field-less finding_dismiss behaving as before

preMortem.scenario: New fields enter the finding signature and stale existing findings
preMortem.trigger: finding-verify.ts signing over the new fields
preMortem.mitigation: Keep new fields out of the signature domain; smoke verifies a legacy finding still verifies and signing is unchanged
signature-registry auto-proposes new tags; aliases/mergedInto fold synonyms; active requires human approval
